title: Calling mesh.surface_get_arrays() many times in the same frame freezes the game if you have radeon anti-lag enabled
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4 stable, 4.3 stable, 4.2.2 stable, 4.0 stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.13031.3015) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads)

### Issue description

Calling a MeshInstance3D's mesh.surface_get_arrays() function many times (100-200) in the same frame will freeze the RenderingServer if AMD's Radeon Anti-Lag feature is enabled.
There is no error or anything printed to console and most things get executed normally, including the surface_get_arrays() function, but the freeze will happen in the next rendered frame and it never recovers.

I haven't seen this behaviour with other functions or long frame times.

No issue in Compatibility or in d3d12

### Steps to reproduce

1. Place script on a Node3D
2. Have a child MeshInstance3D named "Cube" with a mesh assigned
3. Have Radeon Anti-Lag on with Vulkan renderer

```gdscript
extends Node3D

@export var num: int = 1000
@onready var cube: MeshInstance3D = $Cube

func _ready() -> void:
	for n in num:
		cube.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp surface_get_arrays freeze if radeon anti-lag.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19198842/mrp.surface_get_arrays.freeze.if.radeon.anti-lag.zip)
